      "text": "\n\n\nThis is an absolute **survival marathon** of a lobby! Titled *\"BPM vs. the World || 7*| FS, RR | W9\"*, this room was a grueling gauntlet of 7 to 9-star maps (mostly Graveyard/Loved Tech, Speed, and Stamina drainers) that lasted for an agonizing **81 maps** over the course of roughly 9 hours. \n\nHere is the breakdown of the lobby\u0027s performances, pseudo-match costs, and the hilarious descent into madness in the chat.\n\n### 📊 Performance \u0026 Match Costs\nSince standard \"Match Cost\" formulas rely on team win/loss records which fluctuate wildly in a rotating Free-for-All / Team VS lobby, the most accurate way to judge performance in an osu!lazer lobby is to look at the **Average Score per Map**. (Lazer normalizes scores to 1,000,000 max).\n\nHere is how the top players stacked up based on their efficiency and endurance:\n\n**1. The Undisputed Iron-Wrist MVP: `wuyiomokunrin`**\n*   **Maps Played:** 81 (100% attendance)\n*   **Total Score:** 35,027,084\n*   **Average Score / Map:** **~432,433**\n*   *Analysis:* wuyiomokunrin is a machine. They played every single map in this brutal 9-hour session and still maintained a highly respectable ~430k average score. To play 81 maps averaging 7.5*+ and not completely break your hand is a legendary feat. \n\n**2. The Highest Peak Performer: `r0k_`**\n*   **Maps Played:** 10\n*   **Total Score:** 5,007,156\n*   **Average Score / Map:** **~500,715**\n*   *Analysis:* Though they only stayed for 10 maps, `r0k_` had the highest raw score output per map in the lobby, meaning they were consistently hitting half-combos or holding incredible accuracy on these brutal 8* maps.\n\n**3. The Solid Contenders: `TerriblyGood` \u0026 `Nefaroxz`**\n*   **TerriblyGood:** 21 maps played | **~427,481** avg score\n*   **Nefaroxz:** 14 maps played | **~410,256** avg score\n*   *Analysis:* Both players put up great numbers while they were in the lobby, keeping pace with wuyiomokunrin\u0027s scoring averages before tapping out to save their wrists.\n\n**4. The Sufferers: `Rabusu` \u0026 `broomstick8513`**\n*   **Rabusu:** 48 maps played | **~336,219** avg score\n*   **broomstick8513:** 28 maps played | **~101,976** avg score\n*   *Analysis:* Rabusu gets a massive shoutout for endurance, playing 48 maps. However, looking at the JSON, they suffered a lot of `F` (Fail) ranks on the 8* and 9* spikes, dragging their average down. Broomstick likely failed very early on most maps they played, reflecting the sheer brutality of the map pool.\n\n**5. The RX (Relax) Abuser: `Niom`**\n*   **Maps Played:** 38\n*   **Total Score:** 2,430,164\n*   **Average Score / Map:** **~63,951** \n*   *Analysis:* Looking at the raw stats, it looks like Niom was the worst player in the lobby—but the JSON reveals the truth. Niom was playing with **RX (Relax)**, **HR**, and **TC (Traceable)**. Because Lazer heavily penalizes RX scores (cutting a 700k score down to around 75k), their total score plummeted. They were actually getting high combo A/S ranks, but the mod penalty hid their true power level.\n\n---\n\n### 🗺️ The Map Pool (Pure Evil)\nThe maps picked were absolutely cooked. Players were routinely thrown into things like:\n*   *Zetsubou no Hana* (**9.02★**)\n*   *Tidal Wave* (**8.91★**)\n*   *Tech god* (**8.65★**)\n*   *Endless Battle* (**8.07★**)\n\nAs `apollothehybrid` accurately stated after a round of HR: *\"whoever mapped that needs to get restricted stat\"* and *\"with hr that was straight ass\"*.\n\n---\n\n### 💬 Chat Vibe Check: Pain, Coping, and AI NPCs\nThe chat log is a perfect chronicle of osu! players losing their sanity over a long session.\n\n*   **Physical Destruction:** By the end, `apollothehybrid` is complaining about his pen slipping, `zyxriaa` notes \"my pen hand hurts\", and `wuyiomokunrin` admits that \"9 hours of play isn\u0027t healthy for me\". They even had a brief interlude discussing the merits of grip tape vs. medical wrap vs. raw-dogging the tablet pen.\n*   **The NPC (`aboodASUS`):** This player joined the lobby purely to be a menace. They never actually played a map. Instead, they spammed Taylor Swift lyrics (\"welcome to new york\"), announced \"i like potato i eat potato evryday and i like it with ketchap\", admitted to hating real-life people in parks, rolled a perfect `100 out of 100` on the `!roll` command, and refused to elaborate. \n*   **The 3-Digit Cosplay:** There was a highly sophisticated measuring contest halfway through the lobby (`8\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003dD`), where players proceeded to compare text-art sizes while `shoxx` accused `YoganSushi` of being homophobic, to which Yogan proudly replied: *\"I am everything the left hates\"*. \n\n**Lobby Summary:** \nA perfect encapsulation of the high-level osu! multiplayer experience. 10% popping off, 40% complaining about physical injuries, 50% absolute brainrot in the chat, and 1 guy (`aboodASUS`) acting like a malfunctioning ChatGPT prompt. 10/10 lobby.",
